_source: No Trial3 manifest entry for CONDIS2_ASCII. PG=0 skips the entire *Increment PG loop (CASE/MOVE/CONST/OTHERWISE validation and record-layout generation), leaving only the fixed COBOL skeleton - same minimal-seed convention used for BABA_ASCII/CHABAN_ASCII/UNLOADIS_ASCII. FILEIN/FILEOUT record/block sizes are placeholders needed for the FD PIC X([FILEIN,1,1,1]) substitutions.
